title: Test Data Must Use the Connector That Owns the Stream

steps.prompt: An architect built a Direct Access data stream → DLO → DMO → Flow path into CRM but has no access to the upstream Direct Access source. They need a few test rows to validate the Flow. Which approach respects how Data 360 ingestion actually works?

options.label: Use the Ingestion API to POST sample payloads directly into the existing Direct Access Data Lake Object to trigger the pipeline
options.rationale: Data Lake Objects are strictly coupled to their originating connector type; the Ingestion API cannot inject records into a DLO owned by a Direct Access stream.

options.label: Stand up a temporary Cloud Storage or File Upload stream mapped to the same target DMO to validate downstream Flow logic safely
options.rationale: Because connector-owned DLOs cannot be injected across connectors, creating a secondary stream mapped to the same harmonized DMO validates downstream Flow logic without corrupting upstream sources.

options.label: Temporarily repoint the CRM Flow to read simulated fixture records from a custom object until live connector access is restored
options.rationale: Testing against a CRM custom object bypasses Data Cloud DMO schemas, data types, and trigger mechanics, leaving the real integration untested.
